question: Can the two selected zero-triple facts on the collective-only target be certified as one shared pair-occurrence containment, and what exact information and work does that certificate require?
assumptions: Eight common-start runners; selected reference 0; threshold 1/8; strict blocking means distance below 1/8; equality is safe; duration and isolated contacts remain separate.
candidate_certificate: For four residual blockers a,b,c,d on a supplied closed window J, construct only the positive-length components of B_a intersect B_b, retaining their lap labels and exact endpoints.

For every such component I, certify by exact unwrapped endpoint phase ranges that both c and d remain in the closed safe phase interval [1/8,7/8] throughout I. Partition I only if a tested phase crosses an integer or threshold boundary.

If every component passes, conclude the single containment B_a intersect B_b subset Safe_c intersect Safe_d and hence the two inclusive-triple exclusions T_abc=T_abd=0. Endpoint contacts are checked separately.

Insert those two exclusions into the already-known five-edge correction U >= C_0-O_cd-T_abc-T_abd. The graph inequality is prior work; this study tests only the shared geometric certificate and its cost.

frozen_cases.name: collective_target
frozen_cases.selection_provenance: The common pair of the frozen lexicographically selected minimal coordinate bounds T_(15,38,61)<=0 and T_(15,38,100)<=0. No new pair selection is permitted.

frozen_cases.name: strict_16
frozen_cases.selection_provenance: The fixed nonempty pair interval P from the prior sparse selector. Its containment in Safe_7 is structural and its containment in Safe_16 is the already-known strict16 triple exclusion.

frozen_cases.name: tight_13
frozen_cases.selection_provenance: The same fixed nonempty pair interval P from the prior sparse selector. This is a required countercontrol: the containment may hold while positive duration still fails and only t=3/8 survives.

frozen_cases.name: doubling_112
frozen_cases.selection_provenance: Pair moments already certify positive duration, so the rule exits without a higher-order query. As a diagnostic only, test all six base pairs and preserve explicit violating occurrences; do not select a post-result pair.

frozen_outputs: Exact base-pair blocking pieces, pair-overlap components, lap labels, complement phase ranges and any endpoint contacts or violations.
For each selected case, the implied two zero triples and the five-edge lower bound computed from the already archived total/single/pair moments.
For doubling112, one exact positive violating point or interval for each of the six candidate containments, if all fail; any success would be retained rather than reinterpreted.

A cost ledger counting base-runner blocking pieces, pair component intersections, complement phase-range checks, threshold partitions and exact rational comparisons. Compare with two separate triple reconstructions and with the old sparse arithmetic tests without calling prior work new.
A reflected-target check with no duplicate selection or independent-example claim.
falsification: A target component on which either 61 or 100 blocks disproves the candidate containment and must be preserved without changing the base pair.
A claimed containment fails if any endpoint or positive cell violates the closed safe condition.
A positive-duration conclusion for tight13 is invalid; its isolated equality at 3/8 must remain separate.
A shared containment does not by itself imply a positive bound: the known five-edge arithmetic must be evaluated.
Abstract cover countermodels from the prior study are not runner configurations and are not used as geometric evidence.
verification_contract: Primary implementation uses direct exact lap-interval intersections and unwrapped phase ranges. A separately authored verifier must reconstruct threshold-event states and check containments pointwise on every open cell and event point without importing primary functions. It must compare exact results and cost-relevant counts, and retain counterexamples for every failed doubling112 pair.
scope: Exactly the selected target pair, the fixed strict16 and tight13 comparison pairs, all six doubling112 pairs as a negative diagnostic, and the target reflection. No LP search, new speed, core, window, reference, pair retuning, broad scan, +7/+9 work, outreach, paid compute, main merge or novelty claim.
status: Finite exact diagnostics are OBSERVED/REPRODUCED. Any general selection or bounded-cost implication remains OPEN/HYPOTHESIS. Internal AI agreement is not independent mathematical validation.
